asr_text: Some mornings, I choose a quiet corner because I need to think. On other days, I sit where conversation is easy. A different desk can bring me closer to people from another department. It can also give me distance when a workplace relationship feels uncomfortable, or when I simply need room. Since working from home gave me a place of my own, I do not need one fixed spot at the office. I value being able to change my surroundings and choose a place that fits my mood, my task, and the people I need, or do not need, around me.
